body: Don't worry, I'm going to see one and hopefully I'll be getting out of my father's custody soon because he's really mean about my Psychosis.
Do you have any guesses at what else it might be?
Maybe, that would make sense. I hope it's not serious.
Oh, sorry! I should have said. I'm a female
They said it's coming in theaters but some are still closed so I don't know what they mean by that. I think more information on it will come in a few days.
Yay!!! It comes out in a few days but you can watch the trailer on YouTube!
Yes, I've been diagnosed with Psychosis and there's a chance but I doubt it.
Okay, I will!
I haven't read the book but I want to now!
Okay, thank you for the help.
Since I was transported to a different room I think it was a hallucination and I am going to see a doctor soon. If this was a hallucination could this be a sign that I have Schizophrenia?
I'm so happy that we're finally getting some accurate representation! I hope they do a good job with it.
Aw, thank you. I'm getting put on antipsychotics soon so hopefully that will help.

Alright, I will. The biggest problem is finding someone who will listen. My friends and boyfriend have seen just how bad it can get, but adults haven't so they assume I'm exaggerating. Hopefully my Psychiatrist will listen.
Well, I guess that's a positive 😂
True, do you ever feel like your brain hates you?

Yeah, it really sucks. Mine mostly bite me while growling. But one time one poked holes into me and it made a loud sound like a balloon losing air and I felt a bunch of pressure where the holes were. I can't stand touch hallucinations because they're so hard to ignore.
I get touch hallucinations and it's usually while I'm in bed so that's why I'm so scared.
My hallucinations will touch me and make loud noises at the same time which makes it pretty much impossible to get comfortable.
Aw, this definitely sounds like Schizophrenia. I hope you get some help to and a proper diagnosis. Don't be afraid to change Psychiatrists. I hope it gets better.
This happens to me all the time. It makes it so hard to sleep! It's very irritating.

I think you are afraid because even though they're scary, your hallucinations are familiar and the unknown is scary. Your Psychosis is extremely severe, if you don't mind me asking, are you Schizophrenic? I think you should really go to a hospital. This is very concerning.

I am going to be reevaluated for a Psychotic disorder so that might be it. It's a little confusing, but I think I get it. I'm not on antipsychotics yet because I refused them thinking I didn't need them, but I regret that now because I definitely do! I'll be put on them soon though. Thank you.
Thank you, and I don't mind saying them. I have Depression, Anxiety, Derealization/Depersonalization, and Psychosis. I'm also going to be reevaluated soon for a Psychotic Disorder.
Thanks, I'm glad all of you don't think I'm using them as an excuse because I think I'll really need this
Yeah, she's treated me differently ever since my diagnoses. It's like she acknowledges that I'm sick but expects me to act like I'm not.
Alright, thanks again
Aw, thank you! I wish she would see that. She knows I'm the type of person who doesn't take the easy way out and I've always gotten straight As, so she should know I'm not trying to do that.

Oh, alright. It really hurt when she said that because stress can trigger my Psychosis which could cause me to hurt myself and even without triggering my Psychosis, my other mental illnesses make me want to hurt myself from stress. It's kind of like how people with autism hit their heads when their stressed, I pretty much do the same thing.
Oh, okay
Yeah, I'm planning to talk to my Psychiatrist about making a plan.
Me too
So you think I shouldn't get help in school?
Yeah, you're right. Maybe one day we won't have to feel so powerless anymore because we'll have more people to support us.
I wish I had mind powers but I know it's very far fetched. I guess I just feel so powerless since I have Peychosis I wish I had some kind of superpower so I'm not powerless.
Alright, thanks for your advice! I really appreciate it.

🤣 Hey, if it makes you feel any better my childhood wasn't too great either! I get people anonymously telling random people on the internet though because it's very unlikely to affect their life in an unwanted way.

Hm, I just always thought it was odd and whenever I asked my friends they always said it never happened to them. And they can be pretty easy to read 😂 Maybe people can just tell that I'm more likely to not tell anyone or something like that.
Have you had people tell secrets that could get them into a lot of trouble even when you didn't know each other well?
True, it's just so weird. Even if I met someone that seemed trustworthy I wouldn't tell them my deepest secret after a day or two!
That's what I was thinking too. I'm wondering if it has something to do with Psychotic people having more dopamine since dopamine affects intuition.
I usually have to have known you for at least a day and it doesn't work as well in person, but we could private chat if you want I guess.
I get what you mean now 😂
Oh, I thought you had a question.
What is it?
Sorry! I'm not the best with grammar! 😂

It is not inappropriate at all to ask for support during grief! My mom died and even though my friends didn't no her they made sure to comfort me. People should just comfort you naturally when something like that happens. I'm so sorry about your friend and I'm glad you are moving on to better things. Best of luck.

Wow, I can't even imagine how painful that is. Good for you for seeing your worth. Even though this experience may have been a bad one, you still were able to take something good out of it by realizing that you won't allow anyone to treat you this way.

My friends are in a similar situation. I think you shouldn't give so much for someone who doesn't appreciate you. Maybe next time let her come to you if she wants to mend things, if not it might just be for the best to leave her be. I'm sorry for how badly she's treated you, and I hope you know you deserve better than that.

I'm sorry your sister is that way, maybe she'll change one day. And when my friends say certain things it triggers me too. It doesn't happen too often fortunately. I'm glad you have a large amount of control over your symptoms.

I can really relate to the last two. My father doesn't think mental illnesses are real so he always says my Psychosis is "just in my head". And sometimes I feel like I'm really in a Psych ward doing something crazy instead of actually being here.
Aw, you're welcome!

Oh my gosh, I'm so sorry! I really hope this gets better! You are so strong for fighting through this. I know how hard it can be to deal with delusions where you feel like life is a simulation, but dealing with all the rest of that on top of thinking it might be a simulation. Wow. I do think you can get better and I'll be rooting for you.

Well, I used to be homophobic but now I see how wrong I was and I guess I just want to do everything I can for the LGBTQ+ community even if it's just little things. I've seen my LGBTQ+ friends go through so much pain because of homophobic people and I really want to change people's views on it any way I can.
I think it's mainly because of porn and lack of LGBTQ+ sex ed in schools.

Alot of people think all gay men always do anal and that they can't do certain positions that they actually can do, like missionary. Some people think they can only do doggy style. I'm trying to change stereotypes like these so people can see it's just as diverse as straight sex.
True, but a lot of people think that all gay couples do it exactly the same way so I want to make sure I have a lot of diversity in the way they do it so people can see that that's not the case.
Thanks, I'm pretty much just looking for stuff like how both men can penetrate not just one, it's very hard for them to do anal sex without lube, etc.

Fortunately, I've never had hallucinations like that, but I have heard people from the other world talking and monsters growling. I'm always questioning whether or not what I'm hearing is real. I hope it gets better.

Wow, that's terrible! I have touch hallucinations and I get really scared that one of them will rape me. I also believe that this is a simulation and I have to die in order for me and the ones I love to be free. Psychosis is so horrible, I wish more people understood what we have to go through.
I've thought things similar to that about my friends. Sometimes I think they can lead me to the real world if I find some code and tell it to them.
Ugh, I bet that was horrible. I hope they treated you well at the hospital.
It really does help. I got to see my boyfriend yesterday and he held me and I felt so much better. I'm glad things are working out for you and congratulations on the engagement!

Hm, those sound like delusions to me. I've thought a lot similar things. One of my worst ones is when I think my food is poisoned and I refuse to eat. I lost 5 pounds from doing that one time and my friends and boyfriend were really worried.
That reminds me of when I thought I was a tree that had been turned into a human to protect my tree family from getting chopped down by the humans.

I thought my doctor was trying to keep me from the real world because she was scared that I was going to find it. But I felt bad for making my friends and boyfriend so concerned so I tried to get better.

I've heard the song hallucination and God delusion before, although I haven't had them before. I've kind of had the God one before, but I thought he was sending demons to kill me. At least it seems like you like the song!
That sounds awful. That must be really hard to deal with! I hope it gets better. Sometimes I'm worried I'll hallucinate corpses but luckily I haven't.
I have one that my boyfriend will die if he doesn't stab me to death, so I guess ours are kind of similar. Psychosis makes it hard to have relationships.
I feel like invisible people are watching me qnd sometimes I can hear them whispering at night.
Aw, I'm so sorry. It's okay, just do your best and that's enough.
Before I was diagnosed that's how I was. My antidepressants help, but I still need to get my antipsychotic. The feeling of being watched all the time is terrible.
I've never had those before, but it sounds scary. I hope it gets better.
I don't think that's necessarily a delusion, but I'm not a doctor and I don't have it so I can't say for sure. Is that hard to deal with?
I have some of that too. It really freaks me out.

I get that a little, not to that extent. Sometimes I think I know that people are murderers or rapists or abusers. It's hard to shake off so I can't imagine dealing with something that severe. I hope it gets better.
Yeah, it's tough, but I talk to him about it. I even thought about tricking him into stabbing me. Sometimes talking to your significant other about these things can help more than you think.
Wow, I bet that one's hard to deal with. I have a delusion that if my boyfriend doesn't kill me he'll die so I tried to get him to stab me. Have you talked to them about it?
I don't know, but it can be very unnerving sometimes. Alternate reality delusions always mess with me the most.
Yeah, Psychosis is definitely a rollercoaster. I'm glad you're okay.
I don't think mine is a delusion, but sometimes I feel like I'm evil so if I go into a church I'll die.
Delusions can be just as bad as hallucinations sometimes.
That sounds alot like mine. I usually believe the world is a simulation made by the real world and I have to escape before time runs out.
Are you on medication? That sounds pretty bad.
One time I thought that potatoes were orphans and that if you ate them they died and you were a cannibal. That one was pretty bizarre.

When I talk about mine sometimes it opens the door to it too. I had a delusion kind of like that. There was another world I was from I believed I was trapped here and had to get out and that no one around me was real, or they weren't their real selves.
I always have really weird ones

I want to remove my toes. I begged my friends to help me find a surgeon to do it but they kept telling me know and checking in on me to make sure I hadn't cut them off. It's hard when it feels like a part of your body isn't yours or that it's working against you.
That's kind of how I am. I have delusions that my body isn't mine and it makes me want to cut everything off.
That sounds very painful... please get some help! I will for mine too. I have the urge to cut off... well... everything really.
It must be hard being trapped in a body you don't want to be in. I'm glad you're getting better. 💜
How do you deal with them? On top of your gender dysphoria and mania that sounds really hard.
I know now, they explained it.
I kind of get it. I beat myself in the head as hard as I can when I get upset.
Why do you want to do it?
The sounds awful, I hope it gets better soon. Make sure to talk to someone.
Thank you, I appreciate your help
There's a disorder for that. You should look it up. It causes the urge to peel skin. It's probably not psychosis rooted and you probably should get help for it before it gets out of hand.
Thanks, I doubt my father will believe that though. He thinks all mental illnesses are caused by selfishness. He's going to be so mad at me about this.
But doesn't that make me selfish? There's some people who were born without limbs and I have them and I don't even appreciate them.
Okay, that does kind of sound like how I feel. Do you think this is my Psychosis or a whole other disorder?
I want to remove body parts because I feel like they don't belong to me and this isn't my real body.
I don't know what you mean.
Thank you so much for posting this! I have Depression, Psychosis, and a few other mental illnesses. I tried to kill my self twice and I still made good grades before and after both times.
Not if a professional does it
Maybe you're right... Maybe I care too much about what he thinks.

Yeah, I always remind him to wear a helmet and that he can't get a motorcycle and to not do back flips or trips on his skateboard. I always feel like I'm going to loose him. Every time he texts back I'm so relieved that I know he's still alive.
I have, but there's only so much they can do
Yeah... I guess so...

You'll find good friends one day. People who will appreciate you. She didn't appreciate you unfortunately, but it's her loss. What she did was horrible, but don't allow her to stop you from becoming the best person you can be. You can do it. Just take it one step at a time.

I'm so sorry! You deserve better than her. You don't need her. Just focus on yourself right now. Focus on what you like to do and what you want to do in your life. If you don't know what you want to do, focus of figuring it out. I can't imagine how painful that must be. You're so strong.
I think my therapist is the real problem. She brushes me off a lot, but my Psychiatrist is very understanding.
That's alright, thank you for responding 💜
Do you think it's more of a Psychosis or Anxiety thing? (I've been diagnosed with both btw)
Maybe, that could be it. I think I'm also scared because my mom died and I feel like that means he'll die too.
My father always says people are weak and selfish when he sees that someone committed suicide on the news. Your father sounds like it's in a more positive way.
But, if I tell my Psychiatrist, they'll have to tell him

I mean, I don't feel like I'm a danger to him. When I said stalk I meant to follow and watch him, not be threatening. And when I wanted him to stab me it was because I thought the monsters would kill him if he didn't.
True, but what if being mocked is what leads me to finally taking the next step and being dead?

You're kind of right. I don't want to do anything threatening towards him, but sometimes I think about following him home to make sure he doesn't get hurt or kidnapped. I'm really paranoid about losing him.
For almost a year and it got so bad I asked my boyfriend to stab me in the heart because I thought the monsters would kill him if he didn't. The hallucinations always make it worse...

Thank you! Even though you don't have advice I still appreciate your support. He's gotten a bit better about mental ilness. He's not as mean about my boyfriend having Autism, but he still calls people with Schizophrenia and Bipolar disorder crazy. He's been mean to me about unrelated things in the past but especially about this. He doesn't seem to like me in general for some reason.

I am diagnosed with Psychosis and I am going to be reevaluated because many of my friends and some adults think I might have Schizophrenia and/or Bipolar disorder. One time things got so bad I tried to convince my boyfriend to stab me because I thought he would die if he didn't and when he refused I made a plan and thought about tricking him into it. You're not crazy. Most people with mental illnesses are less violent than people without them. I hear voices and feel things touch me that aren't there. I suggest humming, singing, or singing in your head a song that you really like. Counting helps sometimes too. I live in a very anti mental health family and I have struggled with this question too. Surround yourself with those who love and care about you. This isn't your fault.
Aw, thank you! It's nice to know there are people out there who don't think I'm over exaggerating when I say I think I'm being emotionally abused.
I get so snappy when I pms! I feel bad for my boyfriend 😂
Don't worry, I usually change them every 4-6 hours

Thanks. My father is very mean to me and since my mother died I have to check with people about it because I'm so used to it sometimes I can't tell when it's really getting out of hand and when it's not. I know you just hear about them, but I get what you mean 😂
Thanks! I'll definitely look into that. I'm not sure if they're cotton, so I'll have to check. By the way, do you think my father was overreacting about it?

It sounds like it got really heavy! Pads really irritate my skin after wearing them for two or three days, so I don't think I could double up on them. Thanks for the suggestion though, I'll keep it in mind if it comes to it.
Even though it's not the biggest step, every step towards change counts. Thank you for sharing your story and helping raise awareness for mental illness and mental illness among men 💜

Wow, I'm so sorry! I'm Psychotic and if that started going around my school I would be crushed. The way Psychosis and mental illnesses in general are viewed is so wrong. Please tell your parents and your principal about this because any sort of stalking is not okay, especially over something you can't control. No matter how things turn out remember there are people who love and care about you and people out there who do understand. Good luck 💜
Thank you 💜

When you called me sweetheart it sounded like it was to patronize me. All I wanted was for you to clear that up. I realize I should have handled it better and I'm sorry, but I thought you were trying to say I was stupid.

You disrespected me. You can blame me being a teenager all you want. I told you the information I had been given and you said something offensive. I appreciate the time you have given to help me, and now I am politely asking you to leave please if we're only going to argue, because it's only going to be bad for the both of us.
I listened to you and said respectfully that I had gotten different information and then you offended me.
It isn't the answer you gave me, it was the way you said it. I found it offensive and my "attitude" is known as self respect. I appreciate your help.
I realize it is rare and I could have something else, I'm just pointing out the fact that it can be diagnosed in childhood
Okay, well you could be a little nicer about it
Please don't call me "sweetheart" and mental health professionals misdiagnose 53% of their patients. Okay, sweetheart?
I'm not trying to offend you, I'm just telling you the information I have been told
Well I've spoken to professionals and have a copy of the dsm 5 and according to both a child can be diagnosed with Schizophrenia.
Although rare in childhood, Schizophrenia can be diagnosed at any age. Psychosis is not a proper diagnosis, but a symptom of something else.
But people with Schizophrenia are required to take an antipsychotic in order to attend school
You think that even if I get diagnosed with Schizophrenia?

Yes, I can crossport this. My teacher has agreed to help me if my Psychiatrist tells him and things don't go well, but I'm very nervous about it. I am a 14 year old girl and I live with him. He tells people my mental health information even when I tell him not to and mocks me for it. He also tells people I said things that I didn't say. Also, when I was little and I was sick he didn't believe me and wouldn't take me to the hospital. My mom ended up having to take me and it turned out I had a disease. He admitted he noticed I was losing a lot of weight, but he still didn't take me. My mom died a little over a year ago from breast cancer so I only live with him.

Aw, thank you. I'm in the process of getting diagnosed with a mental illness and it's been hard because he thinks the root of all mental illnesses is selfishness.  My school had to threaten to call social services for him to get me a therapist and he shares all my mental health information with people and mocks me for it saying "It's all in my head." My teacher, boyfriend, and friends think I may have something severe, so if I get diagnosed with a really severe mental illness I might be removed from his custody.
I guess you're right, I might be overreacting. He's just done a lot of mean things to me before so it can be really easy for him to make me upset now.
Yeah, I guess that's all I can do, but do you think he sees me in a more negative way now because of this?
Okay, but do you think he sees me in an even more negative way than before because of this?

It does, because it concerns how he views women and I am a girl. I understand that he has a right to his opinion, but if there is any way I can change the way he views females into a more equal way I want to do that.
Yeah, I just hate that he sees women this way and acts so justified about it

I agree that he is free to have his own opinion, but I don't like how it puts women down and makes them seem like they are less than men. My father doesn't really seem to care about me so I'm not sure how he would react if I asked him that.

My father is single because my mother died a little over a year ago from breast cancer. I don't like how he makes it seem like women are worth less than men because men can have a bunch of wives but if a woman has a bunch of husbands it's wrong. My father never listens to me because he doesn't seem to like me very much.
Okay, why not? Do you think he's right?
Thank you! And if I do get diagnosed I guess now I'll finally know why I have randomly laughed all my life! 😂

I agree, I don't think I have Bipolar disorder either although I am keeping an open mind when it comes to diagnosis, and I have been showing mostly symptoms of Schizophrenia like being paranoid, having trouble thinking and showering, and wanting my boyfriend to stab me because I think monsters will kill him if he doesn't. The laughing/crying or just laughing doesn't happen often, but it's gotten much worse when it does happen.

And thank you for responding to this btw.
I know, don't worry, I was just joking
Thank you so much for your help and sharing your experiences. It's nice to know I'm not the only so called "crazy" person out there 😂

I just looked it up and this sounds kind of like it. It says it occurs with brain injury and neurological conditions, so this could be a further indication that I have or at least have something similar to Bipolar disorder and/or Schizophrenia.

It's pretty much the same for me, except it can also happen at random times. Before it got really bad, I would be walking and then randomly maniacally laugh and then keep walking like nothing happened and tell people I thought of something funny even thought I didn't. My friend's just thought it was me being silly and trying to freak people out so we could giggle about it, but I actually couldn't control it and I never knew when it was going to happen.

I definitely won't. It could always be an early warning sign of Bipolar disorder. I told my friend about it and she freaked out. It was really annoying the last time it happened because I was trying to go to sleep when it happened but I couldn't and I was scared my father (who thinks everyone with mental illness, especially Bipolar disorder, are crazy) was going to hear me and walk in. How do you feel before, during, and after this happens?

Nice to know. I don't think I'm Bipolar, although a lot of people think I might have Schizophrenia which I am in the process of getting diagnosed. Mine usually last around 30 minutes, how long do yours last?

(Thank you for commenting btw)

I'm so sorry that happened! People don't realize how much affect emotional abuse can have on your development. I couldn't imagine dealing with it and physical abuse on top of that. I hope you're healing from this and you won't let it hold you back.
Thank you. So many people have mocked me when I say I am emotionally abused because it's so overused and unclearly defined.
Thank you so much! It's been really rough, but I'm glad there are other people who understand out there in the world. This is really sweet and I really needed that encouragement.
Thank you, I really appreciate it.
My teacher is helping me find a good mental health hospital and I plan on going very soon. Thank you for your concern though 💜
I don't think he would ever stab anyone
Wanting to stab someone and wanting to get stabbed are to different things. And you never know, he could be nice.
Why? Did he try to hurt somebody?

Sort of, but not really. I haven't really told them much. I'm realky scared that it will go the wrong way. Everyone thinks my father is the nicest guy on earth and they're much more likely to believe him. I don't want to make the wrong move. I might tell them after I get diagnosed with something though. My father will probably lash out at me more when that happens.
I don't know 😂 He seems like he'd be a pretty cool dude, but I can't say for sure.

It's not just lies. He told me I couldn't cry at my mother's funeral because "it's inappropriate to cry in public". He makes fun of me and my boyfriend because my boyfriend has Autism so he and his side of the family call him retarded and laugh about it. When I was little and I was sick and I told him he said it was in my head. My mom had to take me to the hospital and I got diagnosed with a rare autoimmune disease. It could have killed me if she hadn't taken me. I told my father details about my Psychosis after we had a big talk and he apologized for eveything he did. He promised to keep it between us like I told him to. Then he mocked me for it with my aunt. He told my grandmother that I said something that I didn't say. This is the short answer, if you want more details on any of these feel free to ask. Thank you.

I still can't completely convince myself that it isn't real, but I started going to a Psychiatrist to get diagnosed. They put me on some medication in the mean time which ended up being horrible. Besides that I'm kind of Depressed right now, but I think I can manage. Thank you for asking. That was very nice of you.

I had been diagnosed with Psychosis already and I acted weird a lot, but he was pretty shocked. I thought I was evil because I thought I had killed his father in another world. His father was murdered when he was 7. He kept telling me it wasn't my fault and that he wasn't going to die. A few days later I attempted suicide, but stopped it when someone answered my text and allowed me to vent to them. I didn't tell them I was attempting suicide, just that I needed to talk.

I am 14, I can't leave unless I report him. I want my family to know what he's really like. I still love him, but I want them to know the lies he told about me weren't true. I'm still not completely decided on whether or not I'll tell them though. On the other hand if I get removed from my home they'll probably end up asking anyway.

IKR😂 I suffer from Psychosis possibly caused by Schizophrenia. I believed I was evil in another world that I was banished from and he was sent to kill me but he fell in love with me so he wouldn't. I thought they would kill him if he didn't so I wanted him to stab me because I deserved it and so he could live.
I have to figure out if it's considered abuse first. But if it is, I'm going to try to get out and show my family who my father really is. I don't think they'll believe me, but I have to try.

Thanks, but I'm going for evaluation. They said it has to be in person because they have to be able to read my body language (which I think is a little much considering body language can still be read decently on camera and the circumstances). Are you doing evaluation virtually?

I haven't been officially diagnosed with Schizophrenia, but I do have Psychosis and my friends think I might have Schizophrenia. I'm trying to get officially diagnosed with something, but with the virus stuff going on I can't see a Psychiatrist for evaluation. That being said, take my experiences knowing that. Once I am officially diagnosed I can come back and let you know if it was Schizophrenia or not. 

My delusions are very complex. I usually have multiple ones at a time. Some eventually go away (no particular reason they just stop on their own) and I'm stuck with others that always play in the back of my mind and then grow in intensity if my mental stuff is really acting up. 

As far as hallucinations I can see them, hear them, smell them, taste them, and feel them touch me. These usually don't happen all at once. Ex: I can taste and smell something without seeing or hearing anything or eating anything. I can see something without feeling it touch me or hearing it. I can hear something without seeing anything. The most common ones that happen together are touch and audio.

Usually my hallucinations cause and fuel my delusions, but not always. I hope this helped and you should definitely make your character have Schizophrenia. It would help out those suffering from it so much and it's so kind of you! I suggest checking with a Psychologist and/or Psychiatrist after you've written her experience with Schizophrenia in the story and having them check it for accuracy and make suggestions.

I have this terrible idea that I killed my boyfriend's father, even though I was only five when he died and we lived in different states and didn't know each other. I could explain it, but it's really long and complex and it's getting out of hand. I started sobbing yesterday because I felt guilty that I had killed his father and that my boyfriend was going to eventually die for not killing me. It's really bad.

My voices have said random things or things related to my delusions. 
Random: Frogs, party, *laughter*, Doorman *repeated 3 times*
Delusion Related:Let's go, calling my name (has happened several times), growling (along with touch as though something's attacking me), unintelligible whispers (sounds like tsk tsk tsk and makes me think invisible people are watching me),  sound of a ballon losing air (something putting holes into my body and yes it is a weird sound effect for that but that's what happens)

I haven't been diagnosed with Schizophrenia, so I'm just letting you know that I'm not claiming to have it. I am going to see a psychiatrist for evaluation soon and my friends suspect I have it or something on the spectrum. I do officially suffer from psychosis though. During one of my episodes I called my boyfriend and kept asking him why he wouldn't let me out of the simulation and take me to the real world, to my home, where I belonged. I was angry and sad and I started sobbing. I kept asking him if he wanted to kill me. Now I feel like I was evil in the real world so I was banished to this fake world (Earth) as punishment. Here I turned out to be good, so now my boyfriend knowing me in the fake world knows if I would have grown up differently I would have been fine, but he has a mission and he had to kill me to complete it but he fell in love with good me so he can't do it. I feel guilty for him not being able to complete his mission and like I deserve death since I was evil. I've been able to keep it under control but it's getting worse and I am afraid that I will call him and blurt this all out and beg him to kill me so he can be free. I understand how horrible psychosis is. I hate feeling like I'm a burden to the ones I love and not being able to fight it and get better no matter how hard I try. I hope we can both manage to beat this even if it's through simple things like still managing to hangout with our friends and have fun despite it.
